summary: Root cause found: orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh never writes state.json status="partial" on a partial dispatch outcome, so orchestrate-triage-classify.sh's already-existing partial+blockers->needs_human routing rule never fires. Fix: call the already-wired postflight:partial transition unconditionally on dispatch_status=partial; needs zero orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh changes. Rejects status=blocked (falls into a silent dependency-discharge skip bucket).

artifacts.summary: Research report deciding the postflight fix approach for partial+blocker[] redispatch.
